notablePrerequisites:
Necrosynthesis attached to Tayam.
Wingrattle Scarecrow does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Wingrattle Scarecrow, adding {C}{C}.
When Wingrattle Scarecrow dies, its persist ability and Necrosynthesis trigger.
Resolve the Wingrattle Scarecrow trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter and a vigilance counter on it.
Resolve the Necrosynthesis trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on Tayam.
Activate Tayam by paying {3}, removing a +1/+1 counter from Tayam, and both counters from Wingrattle Scarecrow.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Wingrattle Scarecrow, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat steps 2-4 one additional time.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Wingrattle Scarecrow, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve Tayam's ability from step 5, causing you to mill three cards and returning Wingrattle Scarecrow from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.
